name: services/events/unsubscribe
description:
Unsubscribe from previously subscribed event notifications.

The parameters you pass to this method form a filter. This filter will be used to search your (the Consumer's) subscriptions. The ones that match the filter will be deleted.

arguments.name: event_type
arguments.description: The event type of a subscription.

arguments.name: callback_url
arguments.description: The callback URL of a subscription.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

errors:
• object_not_found - some of the referenced objects do not exist.

    Possible reasons:

    • subscriptions_not_found - There are no subscriptions matching criteria.
